An atlas of particle worlds. Particles pull on each other from far away and push apart up close. Pick a world on the map, change its forces and rules, or click the canvas to add a ring.

Pull falls off with distance squared, push with distance cubed, so particles settle about 2.0 units apart.

Ecosystem

Each row is the species that moves, each column the species it reacts to, so the rules can be one-sided: a row pulled toward a column that pushes it away is a chase. Pull below zero repels at long range. Two species settle about 2 × push ÷ pull apart.

Saved presets stay in this browser. Mix species deals the current setup's particles out to the species in turn.
